root_text: For your information "HPV Virus" is not HMPV/HMP Virus. It's a misspelling of it so don't get confused. HMP Virus is the same as HMPV Virus but they just remove the V.

nodes.author: TheVirusAlert
nodes.text: For your information "HPV Virus" is not HMPV/HMP Virus. It's a misspelling of it so don't get confused. HMP Virus is the same as HMPV Virus but they just remove the V.

nodes.author: TheVirusAlert
nodes.text: HPV Virus is a "human papillomavirus" while HMPV/HMP virus is a "human metapneumovirus"
